This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Biology and appearance==
This diminutive bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their hunched posture, [[Color|pink]] and brown skin, and elongated pointy [[Bone|craniums]], with wide [[nose]]s, bulging, dark [[eye]]s, and small fleshy fins on the back sides of their heads.<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species swept the halls of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] just prior to the [[Mission to Khofar]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Day (episode)|fourth episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Alex García López]].<ref name="The Acolyte" /> During this debut, [[Charlotte Louise]] portrayed this alien, revealing it to be nicknamed the "sassy old lady." The character was performed with the puppeteer at a full ninety degree angle, resulting in the character being the height of her hips. Louise felt that the character was fun to play, finding the alien one of her favorites from ''The Acolyte''.<ref name="LadyAcolyte">{{Instagram|username=charlotte_louise_baker|url=sp/DKZT58msa2A|date=2025-06-02|quote=My sassy old lady creature from "The Acolyte". This creature is performed at complete 90 degree angle, so it is the height of my hips. She was such a fun one to play, probably one of my favourites from the series 🥰👽 She was a guest at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant 💫|archivefile=File:CharlotteLouise-TheAcolyte-Instagram.png}}</ref>
